question: What are the name of badges that users who have the lowest reputation obtained?
evidence: lowest reputation refers to Min(Reputation); user refers to UserId
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching badges record.
gold: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)
gold0: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)

b.request: Find the names of badges obtained by the user(s) with the minimum reputation, using a left join from those users to badges so that a lowest-reputation user with no badge records is still kept (with a NULL badge name)
b.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)

d.request: What are the names of the badges obtained by the users with the lowest reputation (the minimum Reputation), and also include users with the lowest reputation who have no matching badges record?
d.sql: SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name FROM users u LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MIN(Reputation) FROM users)
